title: M/s S.M.R. Ispat Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Saral Srivastava, J.; Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal, J.
headnote: A writ challenging PVVNL's additional-security demand under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, was dismissed as not pressed. In 2012 the Court had connected the petition with a similar pending writ and, without prejudice, restrained the licensee from demanding additional security; the validity of the clause 4.20 demand was never decided.
facts: M/s S.M.R. Ispat Pvt. Ltd. challenged PVVNL's demand notice dated 8 May 2012 seeking additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 4 July 2012 the Court connected the writ with Writ-C No. 51884 of 2009 and, following an interim order dated 7 October 2009 in a similar petition by M/s Supreme Ceramics Limited (Writ Petition No. 51844 of 2009), restrained demand of additional security until further orders. On 1 August 2025 the petitioner declined to press the writ.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the licensee's additional-security demand under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, was dismissed as not pressed. An earlier Division Bench (R.K. Agrawal and Mushaffey Ahmad, JJ., 4 July 2012) had, without prejudice to the parties' rights, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders while connecting the matter with Writ-C No. 51884 of 2009; that interim did not decide the demand.

not_decided.point: Whether additional security was leviable under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Petition dismissed as not pressed; the 2012 restraint was without prejudice and did not adjudicate the demand.
